# gitea_repository_actions_workflows (Data Source)

Lists repository Actions workflows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_actions_workflows" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `total_count` (Number)
- `workflows` (List of Object) Repository workflow definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows))
